label: Adobe gives the packet a selection test for its single accent: the one node the diagram exists to explain, never a default position, at most one per diagram, and split the diagram when two nodes tie.
Adobe shows precedence as a light-to-dark neutral step rather than one hue per stage, a rule the packet lacks for any ordered diagram such as a gantt phase or a process lane.
Adobe says connectors recede to a dark neutral and would drop four or more identical edge labels to zero or one; the packet allows accent connectors and checks no label redundancy.
Adobe layout discipline adds one header per column instead of a phase name in every node, consistent node size and radius per diagram, and aligned parallel chains.
Adobe requires a one-sentence caption for every diagram and cuts anything that does not serve it, including completeness nodes; the packet asks for the reader question but never for the caption.
Adobe enforces cross-diagram consistency on a shared board, which the packet needs once fileKey reuse puts several diagrams beside each other.

Adobe runs a bounded critic pass on the Mermaid and a screenshot after the write, checking clutter, hierarchy, accent misuse, redundant labels and caption match; the packet stops at a read-back count.

Adobe exports a high-resolution screenshot, crops per diagram by board bounding box, normalizes the gray canvas to white and embeds the image with real alt text, the delivery route the packet forbids.

hferello arch-flow independently matches the packet lane table, fixed six ids, dotted async and external edges, no edges to subgraphs, one deployable unit per node; the packet still checks it by machine.

hferello makes the markdown doc the source of truth and the diagram optional, requires labels to match the doc, writes the board link back under a Visual diagram heading, and finishes the doc when the tool is missing.

diagram-codebase turns the packet gate into artifacts: a per-diagram purpose sentence and content hash, a publish review listing what leaves the machine, and a manifest holding Figma ids and the pending action.

diagram-codebase allows 25 nodes and 30 edges per diagram, 12-20 for a master, nesting at most two, and splits oversized diagrams with every omission in the notes, a midpoint between the packet nine and Figma limits.
The public architecture component library offers owned-versus-external variants and icon overlays that generate_diagram cannot express, marking a capability boundary the packet should not promise.
